outcome: Maternal outcome (risk of severe preeclampsia, APH, PPH, caesarean section)
Fetal outcome (birth weight, preterm deliveries, IUGR)
cohort: Pregnant women between 12 to 20 weeks gestation with high risk for preeclampsia.
finding: Low dose aspirin 150 mg significantly reduces the incidence and severity of early onset preeclampsia, improving both maternal (reduced risk of severe preeclampsia, APH, PPH, and caesarean section) and fetal outcomes (improved birth weight, reduced preterm deliveries, and IUGR).
mod_finding: Aspirin treatment did not hamper the onset of spontaneous labour and reduced the incidence of caesarean section.
birth_weight: Improved birth weight was observed as a fetal outcome.
gest_age: Participants were pregnant women between 12 to 20 weeks gestation.
